flow: Infected Humans infectious (P)->Environmental Ebola Pathogens U
Infected Humans infectious (P)->Quarantined Deceased Humans F
Quarantined Deceased Humans F->Buried / Removed K
Quarantined Deceased Humans F->Deceased Humans unburied/handled (S)
Quarantined Deceased Humans F->Buried / Removed K
Environmental Ebola Pathogens U->Buried / Removed K
Deceased Humans unburied/handled (S)->Environmental Ebola Pathogens U
param: α₁ Recruitment/inflow rate into susceptible (alive) human population A
α₂ Recruitment/inflow rate into infected human population P (e.g., infected recruitment/importation)
ψ₁ Effective contact rate for transmission from infected humans P to susceptibles A (direct contact)
ψ₂ Effective contact rate for transmission from environmental pathogens U to susceptibles A (indirect/environmental contact)
ψ₃ Effective contact rate for transmission from deceased humans S to susceptibles A (contact during burial/handling)
ε Natural death rate of humans (applies to living compartments; also appears as removal in some classes per paper notation)
ρ₁ Rate at which infected humans P are quarantined
ρ₂ Rate at which infected humans P shed Ebola pathogens into the environment U
ρ₃ Disease-induced death rate of infected humans P (flow to quarantined-deceased class F in this model)
ω₁ Rate at which quarantined deceased F are buried (flow to buried class K)
ω₂ Rate at which quarantined individuals F contribute to deceased/handled class S (as written in equations)
h Proportion/rate of shedding of deceased individuals S contributing to environmental pathogens U
b Decay/clearance rate of Ebola pathogens in the environment U
c Rate of burial/clearance/removal of deceased humans S (in addition to h)
d External input of Ebola pathogens into the environment U (e.g., bush meat/other sources) as constant source term
